name: patch_moves_1
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys
src=open('src/ZeckMoves.lean').read()
reps=[
("  | succ k ih => rw [run_succ, ih, ← run_succ]\n","  | succ k ih => rw [run_succ step a (k + 1), ih, run_succ step (step a) k]\n"),
("  unfold d\n  rw [if_neg (by omega)]\n  simp\n","  have hne : ¬ (i % 2 = 0) := by omega\n  unfold d\n  rw [ite_cond_eq_false _ _ (eq_false hne)]\n  simp\n"),
("  unfold d\n  rw [if_pos h]\n  omega\n","  unfold d\n  rw [ite_cond_eq_true _ _ (eq_true h)]\n  omega\n"),
("  have h1 : (x + single i' 1 + single (i' + 1) 1) i' = x i' + 1 := by","  have h1 : (x + single i' 1 + single (i' + 1) 1 : Pos) i' = x i' + 1 := by"),
("  have h2' : (x + single i' 1 + single (i' + 1) 1) (i' + 1) = x (i' + 1) + 1 := by","  have h2' : (x + single i' 1 + single (i' + 1) 1 : Pos) (i' + 1) = x (i' + 1) + 1 := by"),
("  have h3 : (x + single i' 1 + single (i' + 1) 1) (i' + 2) = x (i' + 2) := by","  have h3 : (x + single i' 1 + single (i' + 1) 1 : Pos) (i' + 2) = x (i' + 2) := by"),
("  have h1 : (x + single (i' + 2) 2) (i' + 2) = x (i' + 2) + 2 := by","  have h1 : (x + single (i' + 2) 2 : Pos) (i' + 2) = x (i' + 2) + 2 := by"),
("  have h2 : (x + single (i' + 2) 2) i' = x i' := by","  have h2 : (x + single (i' + 2) 2 : Pos) i' = x i' := by"),
("  have h4 : (x + single (i' + 2) 2) (i' + 2 + 1) = x (i' + 2 + 1) := by","  have h4 : (x + single (i' + 2) 2 : Pos) (i' + 2 + 1) = x (i' + 2 + 1) := by"),
("  have h1 : (x + single 2 2) 2 = x 2 + 2 := by","  have h1 : (x + single 2 2 : Pos) 2 = x 2 + 2 := by"),
("  have h2 : (x + single 2 2) 1 = x 1 := by","  have h2 : (x + single 2 2 : Pos) 1 = x 1 := by"),
("  have h3 : (x + single 2 2) 3 = x 3 := by","  have h3 : (x + single 2 2 : Pos) 3 = x 3 := by"),
("  have h1 : (x + single 1 2) 1 = x 1 + 2 := by","  have h1 : (x + single 1 2 : Pos) 1 = x 1 + 2 := by"),
("  have h2 : (x + single 1 2) 2 = x 2 := by","  have h2 : (x + single 1 2 : Pos) 2 = x 2 := by"),
]
for o,n in reps:
    assert o in src,o
    src=src.replace(o,n)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','src/ZeckMoves.lean'],input=src,text=True,capture_output=True)
print(r.returncode,r.stderr)
